capabilities: wrap selected text in <ruby>/<rt> markup via a command
extras: README is a stub pointing to a screenshot elsewhere; it lists a TODO for auto-converting kanji to hiragana, so that feature does not exist yet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command for marking up furigana, so users must write <ruby> HTML syntax by hand.
summary: Adds a command that wraps selected text in <ruby>/<rt> tags so furigana readings display over kanji.
